content: Letter 34, to Amīr ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn Gīlānī (ca. 831-32/1428-29, Gilan?): a letter of thanks sent after attending the amir's court and enjoying his solicitude, after the events of 830/1427; Ibn Turka calls himself sitam-dīda, a victim of injustice (TMN/M f. 122a, TMN/MS pp. 27-28, TMN/D pp. 203-5).
